role_title: AI Platform, Persistence and Commerce Engineer
charter: Implement and test durable progress, optional cloud recovery, independent commercial ownership, fair reward delivery and operable native service integrations. This is a development owner with executable deliverables, not a planning-only adviser.

backlog_coverage.title: Complete account lifecycle and branch recovery
Build the entitlement and claim ledger
Integrate optional ads and equal free rewards
Complete privacy and service recovery flows

implemented_now.artifact_type: engine-neutral envelope contract and executable validator
validates: Strict versioned envelope fields, types, UTC timestamp shape and UUIDs
Root/child revision lineage and fork recovery references
Pinned economic config identity and optional source-file digest
Pending identity uniqueness, branch/revision/config preconditions, already-applied exclusion
Offline settlement interval origin and single-pending settlement
Commerce is explicitly an untrusted cache outside opaque gameplay payload
does_not_validate: Gameplay state correctness, including numbers, timers, policy and content state
Actual atomic durability, migrations, backup existence or cloud revision enforcement
Receipt authenticity, grant delivery, refunds or independently verified ownership
True elapsed time on an offline device
Native runtime integrations or full v1 readiness

capabilities_observed.method: Read-only local version/path probes; no SDK installation, account access, signing changes, deployment or live purchase.

execution_program.task: Qualify iOS and Android service adapters
inputs: Selected engine/export candidate from integration lead
Non-secret sandbox product IDs and authorized developer account access
outputs: Throwaway native probe builds
SDK dependency inventory and version lock
Recorded sandbox purchase, restore, ad no-fill and cloud conflict results
acceptance: Both platforms install and run representative builds
Pending purchases grant nothing; verified completion grants once; restore is demonstrated
A failed ad leaves the equal briefing reward route usable
Concurrent cloud revisions are detected without overwriting another branch
execution_program.current_boundary: Native export and service evidence is still absent. Xcode is installed; Android build capability is not established.

execution_program.task: Implement durable local persistence around the approved envelope
outputs: Atomic write and replace implementation
Rolling backups, corruption detection, export/import
Versioned migrations and interrupted transaction recovery
acceptance: Inject interruption before, during and after commit; recover to a complete valid old or new snapshot
Replay an interrupted grant without duplicating rewards
Malformed or future-version imports fail without overwriting the current save
Migrations preserve balances, timers, identity and recoverable source copies
execution_program.current_boundary: Contract and 43 fixtures implemented; filesystem durability and migration acceptance are not implemented.

outputs: Immutable version registry
Config digest verification and fallback loader
Version transition committed after prior offline interval settlement
acceptance: A downloaded config cannot change the unsettled interval
Unknown versions and incorrect digests are rejected before state mutation
The previous validated bundle remains available offline
Schema compatibility is checked before adoption
execution_program.current_boundary: Envelope pins version plus digest; no runtime config registry or transition exists.

execution_program.task: Implement optional accounts and branch-preserving cloud recovery
inputs: Chosen account/cloud adapter with revision preconditions
UX branch comparison and recovery flow
outputs: Guest continuation and optional linking
Revision-based upload and conflict handling
Recoverable branch selection, export, deletion and account recovery
acceptance: Play without an account
Create concurrent offline branches and retain both before selection
Never sum wallets, lifetime earnings or overlapping offline intervals
Recover the unselected branch and re-fetch independent commercial ownership
Deletion and unlinking have explicit local/cloud scope
execution_program.current_boundary: Shape of recovery references is validated, but referenced backup files and cloud behavior are not implemented.

execution_program.task: Implement idempotent claims and independent entitlement storage
outputs: Durable claim IDs and source-component identity ledger
Transactional grant/retry states
Independent commercial entitlement cache and reconciliation adapter
acceptance: Repeated operation, source receipt or callback grants once
Prepared operation is not counted as granted
Cross-device claim conflicts cannot multiply shared rewards
Local save import cannot invent paid ownership
Revocation is reconciled independently of progression branch
execution_program.current_boundary: Pending identity invariants are checked locally; service ledger, receipt verification and atomic grants remain unimplemented.

execution_program.task: Implement native cosmetic commerce and restoration
outputs: Purchase verification, grant, acknowledgement and reconciliation
Restore, interruption, refund/revocation handling
Localized product price adapter and support correlation IDs
acceptance: Pending/unverified payments do not deliver ownership
Duplicate delivery and interrupted grant replay safely
Restoration works on a clean install and selected alternate progress branch
Unknown products fail visibly without economic effect
No raw receipts or credentials are written to ordinary gameplay saves
execution_program.current_boundary: Requires real platform sandbox access; no live transaction is authorized by this handoff.

execution_program.task: Implement equal-value rewarded ads and crew briefings
outputs: Ad and accessible briefing adapters to one allowance ledger
No-fill/refusal/retry behavior
Consent-aware SDK initialization and feature disable switch
acceptance: Both routes deliver identical bounded entitlement
No-fill/refusal leaves briefing available
Duplicate callbacks, relaunch and day-boundary retries cannot create extra tokens
Bonus amounts and real-time expiries match core tests
execution_program.current_boundary: Ad availability and grants are not implemented; simulated callbacks must never be labeled production verification.

execution_program.task: Implement privacy, observability and service recovery
inputs: Approved event dictionary and data retention requirements
outputs: Consent refusal paths, export and deletion
Economy/session instrumentation with privacy filtering
Operational alerts, backups, feature disables and recovery runbooks
acceptance: Inspect actual build traffic and match declarations
Core game still works through service failure
Diagnose a failed purchase using a correlation ID without exposing credentials
Restore staging backups and exercise service outage
No attribution of human retention to simulated users
execution_program.current_boundary: Account jurisdiction and SDK facts must be checked when selected; no compliance outcome is asserted.

execution_program.task: Operate opt-in staged testing and recovery
outputs: Staged access and support process
Purchase reconciliation evidence
Capacity, incident and disable-switch reports
acceptance: Real testers receive support and correct ownership
Service load and recovery are measured
Material balance changes identify separate cohorts
Operating failures are corrected before expanding access
execution_program.current_boundary: Real people and elapsed calendar time are external dependencies that agents cannot fabricate.

outputs: Compatible config rollback or forward repair plan
Launch and stop criteria with named human authority
14-day support coverage and escalation
Season 2 service/operations handoff
acceptance: Rehearse migrated-save forward recovery
Pause a faulty optional feature without damaging core saves
Restore entitlement service and replay safely
Public launch occurs only after explicit release authority and platform acceptance
execution_program.current_boundary: No deployment, signing change, account action or public release performed during this task.

critical_native_proof_gates.requirement: Install and execute a representative export on both target platforms
critical_native_proof_gates.dependency: Selected engine; working Android build chain; iOS/Android reference devices or explicitly stated emulator coverage.

critical_native_proof_gates.requirement: Sandbox purchase, pending, restore, retry, refund/revocation and platform acknowledgement on each target
critical_native_proof_gates.dependency: Authorized developer accounts, configured test products, sandbox credentials and provider-specific verification adapter.

critical_native_proof_gates.requirement: Rewarded ad availability/no-fill and equal free-briefing flow
critical_native_proof_gates.dependency: Selected native SDK and test-only identifiers; audience and consent configuration.

critical_native_proof_gates.requirement: Concurrent cloud revision conflict, both branches recoverable, independent commercial ownership
critical_native_proof_gates.dependency: Chosen account/cloud service and authorized staging environment.

critical_native_proof_gates.requirement: Signed distribution install/update, save migration and commerce recovery
critical_native_proof_gates.dependency: Release authority, signing access, platform review, supported hardware and accepted QA evidence.

external_dependencies: Human product/release authority for account terms, actual spend, publication and unresolved product choices
Developer accounts and legitimate sandbox access; agents do not invent receipts or credentials
Reference iOS/Android devices and functioning build toolchains
Selected staging providers and non-secret SDK/product configuration
Opt-in human testers, real 28-day season/D30 observation and sustained launch support availability
handoff_to_core: Approve versioned gameplay payload and atomic transition result interfaces. Preserve economic config until settlement finishes; return effect IDs and revised pending proposals for durable commit.
handoff_to_client: Render pending/recovery states truthfully. Keep ordinary play possible offline and commerce cache distinguishable from pending verification.
handoff_to_qa: Use the 43 cases as envelope contract evidence only. Add actual interruption, migration, concurrent-device, receipt and native integration tests when the relevant implementations exist.
review_rules: Do not mark old backlog packages complete because a schema passes.
Do not treat a recovery pointer as proof the backup exists.
Do not grant commerce from a local active display flag.
Do not sum divergent progression branches or overlapping elapsed intervals.
Do not equate installed build tools with proven native integration.
